case_title.reason: Matches the title in the judgment header, ROHIT BISHNOI v. THE STATE OF RAJASTHAN & ANR.

number_of_accused.reason: Three respondents-accused (Vikas Vishnoi, Budharam, Rajendra Bishnoi) are the subject of the bail appeals.

accused_gender.quote: Budharam S/o Kojaram; Vikas Vishnoi S/o Hanuman Ram
accused_gender.reason: Male is supported by the 'S/o' (son of) descriptors for the accused.

accused_age.reason: No accused age is stated in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: No religious identity of the accused is stated.

accused_caste.reason: No caste or community of the accused is named in the judgment.

accused_occupation.reason: No occupation of any accused is mentioned.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No statement on the accused's wealth, poverty or class appears.

previous_criminal_record.reason: The judgment does not state any prior criminal record of the accused.

victim_gender.reason: The victim is described as the informant's elder brother, so Male is supported.

victim_age.quote: Vikash Panwar, aged 25 years at the time
victim_age.reason: The judgment expressly states the victim's age as 25.

victim_caste.reason: No caste of the victim is stated.

victim_religion.reason: No religion of the victim is stated.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Prior enmity/dispute: victim had an extra-marital live-in relationship with Nirma, sister of accused Budharam and Vikas Vishnoi, who threatened him by calls and WhatsApp messages
accused_victim_relationship.quote: Budharam and Vikas Vishnoi, Nirma's brothers ... were threatening the informant's brother by way of calls and WhatsApp messages
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Judgment body says Nirma is the accused's sister, not sister-in-law (headnote says sister-in-law); threats named only two accused.

offence_category.reason: The offence is murder under IPC s.302, as charged.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC s.302 r/w s.34 (per FIR); charged with IPC s.302 and s.120B for all three; Arms Act s.3 r/w ss.25 and 27 for Budharam only
statutory_provisions.quote: Budharam was charged for offences punishable under Sections 302 and 120B of the IPC and Section 3 read with Sections 25 and 27 of the Arms Act
statutory_provisions.reason: Omits s.34 IPC from the FIR and wrongly applies the Arms Act charges to all accused rather than only Budharam.

weapon.quote: the butt of a country-made pistol
weapon.reason: A country-made pistol is identified, used to strike the victim and fire bullets.

evidence_type.reason: Listed evidence matches the State's submissions on eyewitnesses, CCTV, recoveries, call records and reconnaissance, which the value flags as State reliance.

confession.reason: No confession or admission by the accused is mentioned.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: The alleged incident is stated to be an instance of honour killing
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Honour killing, conspiracy, active participation and specific roles are all noted by the Court.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating facts are noted by the Court.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Sessions court dismissed Vikas Vishnoi's bail on 10 November 2021; trial is at an early stage with no verdict.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court granted bail on 14 February 2022 and 2 February 2023 as stated.

final_outcome.reason: No conviction or remand; the Supreme Court set aside bail orders, so other is appropriate.

offence_finally_established.reason: No conviction stands; the matter is a bail appeal.

imprisonment_years.reason: No fixed-term sentence exists, so null is correct.

neutral_facts.reason: Summary covers the incident, roles, investigation and evidence without names, court proceedings or outcome.

offence_severity.correct_value: Life imprisonment or death penalty (as stated by the appellant's counsel)
offence_severity.quote: heinous crimes which could result in life imprisonment or even death penalty
offence_severity.reason: The judgment states the possible punishments, though attributed to counsel; 'Not stated' is wrong.

attempt_completion.reason: The victim was shot dead, so the offence was completed.

physical_harm.quote: Budharam was able to fire bullet shots on the chest and back of the deceased, resulting in his death
physical_harm.reason: Gunshot wounds to chest and back causing death, plus head strike with pistol butt, are described.

number_of_offences.reason: Five sections charged across accused and no convictions stand, consistent with a bail matter.

financial_property_loss.reason: No property or money loss is mentioned.

premeditation_planning.quote: the acts of reconnaissance that were carried out by the accused before the alleged fateful incident
premeditation_planning.reason: Court noted prima facie reconnaissance and tracing without finally deciding premeditation.

motive.quote: unhappy about the said extra marital live-in-relationship
motive.reason: Family anger over the relationship, framed as alleged honour killing, is correctly marked as alleged.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Court expressly declined merits findings and relied only on prima facie material.

witness_credibility.quote: one of the prosecution witnesses, namely, Nirma has turned hostile which is not an aspect that must be taken into account
witness_credibility.reason: Hostility is said not to be a mandatory bail factor, and the risk of influence could not be ruled out.

post_offence_conduct.reason: No flight, surrender or concealment after the offence is noted.

custody_duration.quote: Budharam was arrested on 22 May, 2020 while respondents-accused, Rajendra Bishnoi and Vikas Vishnoi were arrested on 30 May, 2020
custody_duration.reason: Arrest dates and judicial custody are stated; total duration is not given.

bail_history.quote: dismissed as withdrawn by an Order dated 16 April, 2021
bail_history.reason: Bail history for each accused matches paragraphs 9 to 12.

trial_duration.reason: Dates for offence, High Court and Supreme Court match; trial judgment not given is accurate.

legal_representation.reason: Appellant, State and respondent counsel names match the judgment's appearance list and para 13.

investigation_status.quote: the police filed a chargesheet before the Metropolitan Magistrate ... on 19 August, 2022
investigation_status.reason: FIR registration, chargesheet filing and pending trial are all supported.

procedural_irregularity.quote: passing a cryptic and casual orders, de hors cogent reasoning
procedural_irregularity.reason: Court found cryptic bail orders without reasons and without considering material aspects.

appeal_history.correct_value: Trial court: Vikas Vishnoi's bail dismissed (10 Nov 2021); no trial-court bail ruling recorded for Budharam or Rajendra Bishnoi. High Court: bail granted (14 Feb 2022 and 2 Feb 2023). Supreme Court: appeals allowed, bail orders set aside, bail cancelled
appeal_history.quote: The same was dismissed by an Order dated 10 November, 2021
appeal_history.reason: Trial-court dismissal applies only to Vikas Vishnoi, but the value states it generally.

prosecution_argument.reason: Matches the State's and appellant's submissions on evidence, conspiracy, participation and cancellation of bail.

defence_argument.reason: Covers prolonged custody, no witness influence, no misuse, and denial of individual roles.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Bail factors, reasoned prima facie view and Article 136 review of cryptic orders are the principles applied.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: All ten cases and their citations match paragraphs 14.3, 18 to 20 of the judgment.

sentencing_rationale.reason: No sentence was imposed, so not applicable is correct.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: The Court weighed no mitigating factors.

judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: the seriousness of the allegations against them
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Court weighed seriousness, prima facie roles, witness influence and tampering risk.

other_sentence_order.quote: Their bail bonds stand cancelled and they are directed to surrender before the concerned jail authorities within a period of two weeks
other_sentence_order.reason: Bail bonds cancelled and surrender within two weeks are the orders given.
